en: Hi, welcome to this course. My name is
Maximilian Schwarzmüller and I will be your
instructor in this course. Now in this
course, we will dive into algorithms. We'll
learn what algorithms are and we'll learn
that from scratch.
Of course, we'll not just learn that, but
you will also learn how you can judge and
compare algorithms, because that will be
super important to find the best possible
solution for a given problem.
Now throughout this course, I will show you
a lot of different kinds of algorithms a lot
of different ways of solving problems, and a
lot of different examples, of course.
We'll see algorithms of different
complexities, simple ones and more complex
ones, and after this first module, we'll
dive into math algorithms, sorting and
search algorithms, algorithms that deal with
arrays and sets, and by the end of the
course, I will give you a plan, basically
like a blueprint you could say, which you
can follow to solve basically any problem.
So with that, let's not waste any time and
let's dive right in.
